languages.question: Can I browse in Arabic or English?
languages.answer: Yes. Switch languages in the header at any time. We will remember your choice for your next visit.

sharing.question: How will I share my invitation?
sharing.answer: Once your invitation is published, you can send its link to your guests on WhatsApp.

subscription.question: Is this a monthly subscription?
subscription.answer: No. Each plan is a one-time payment for one event, with the online period shown above.

refund.question: Is there a refund window?
refund.answer: You can request a refund within 14 days of payment if your invitation is not published.

edits.question: How many edits are allowed?
edits.answer: It depends on the tier you choose. Premium offers up to 40 edits.

after.question: What happens after the event?
after.answer: Your invitation remains online for a grace period depending on the tier, then is automatically removed.

early.title: Our first 100 couples
early.body: We're just starting out, and we're preparing a first group of couples to walk with step by step. Start your invitation and tell us honestly what you think.

q1.q: How does the invitation reach my guests?
q1.a: You get a private link and send it on WhatsApp or any message. As soon as a guest opens it, the invitation opens on their phone.

q2.q: Do guests need to download an app?
q2.a: No, not at all. The invitation is a web page that opens in the browser on iPhone and Android, with no sign-up.

q3.q: Can I edit after I publish?
q3.a: Yes, and the changes appear on the same link. Each plan includes a number of published edits, and Classic includes {n}.

q4.a: You pay in Egyptian pounds, once per event. We're running a demo mode for now, and Fawry and cards will be switched on before launch.

q5.q: How long does it take to get my invitation ready?
q5.a: It's ready in minutes once you enter your names, the wedding date and pick a design.

q6.a: Yes, within 7 days of payment, as long as you haven't published the invitation yet.
